card.name: Covering and light-protective wrapping
card.fires_on: Words in instructions about covering or shielding something, especially "light" before "-protective" or "-blocking", and "cover" or "with" before a covering item.

modes.label: Light-protective covers
modes.description: The word "light" in phrases about shielding a bag, tubing or vial from light.
modes.example: It is not necessary to cover the infusion tubing or to use<< light>>-protective tubing during the infusion.

modes.label: Cover with something
modes.description: "Cover" or the words around it in instructions for covering seeds or containers.
